title: Mission: The Firetruck
subtitle: Meet the rescue team and control the water hose
summary: Explore a real firetruck in 3D, discover its parts, and aim a hose in a firefighter training yard.
activityInstruction: Turn on the pump. Aim the blue circle at each practice flame and spray. Clear all three, then switch the pump off. Refill the tank if needed.
exploreInstruction: Drag to turn the firetruck. Zoom in to look closely at its equipment. In Identify, find the cab, wheels, coiled water hose and rear ladder on the truck.

storyQuestions.success: They saw smoke near the school.
The student pressed the fire alarm.
No, the school was not safe yet.

storyQuestions.prompt: Who can help when there is a fire?
What number should we call for help?
What kind of vehicle can come quickly to help?
storyQuestions.success: A firetruck comes quickly to help.

storyQuestions.prompt: What should that vehicle be able to do?
answers: Move quickly and put out the fire
storyQuestions.success: The firetruck moves quickly and helps put out the fire.

quiz.prompt: Which parts help the firetruck roll along the road?
quiz.success: The wheels turn so the truck can travel.

quiz.prompt: Your water misses the practice flame. What can you change?
quiz.success: Changing the angle changes where the water goes.

quiz.prompt: All the practice flames are out. What finishes the mission?
quiz.success: Switch off the pump when the practice job is done.

parts.label: Crew cab
parts.fact: The crew cab carries the firefighters to their job.
parts.help: Find the front section with windows and seats.

parts.label: Wheels
parts.fact: The wheels turn to help the firetruck travel along the road.
parts.help: Find the round parts underneath the truck.

parts.label: Water hose
parts.fact: The hose carries water from the pump to the nozzle. It coils up for storage on the truck.
parts.help: Find the yellow coiled hose and nozzle on the side, behind the crew cab.

parts.label: Ladder
parts.fact: The ladder at the back helps firefighters climb up to the equipment.
parts.help: Turn the truck and find the narrow ladder with rungs at the back.
